focus_note: An Ingress resource does nothing until an Ingress controller (for example ingress-nginx) is running to put its host and path rules into effect. NetworkPolicies are enforced only by a CNI plugin that supports them, such as Calico or Cilium. Once a policy selects a pod for a direction (ingress or egress), that pod accepts only the traffic in that direction that the policies explicitly allow. Policies only add allowances; there are no deny rules.
